# GazeFocus
GazeFocus is a web app for focus-aware YouTube learning and productivity.

## Main Goal
Help learners stay focused while studying video content and improve consistency through tracking, planning, and reminders.

## Core Features
- Focus-aware playback support
- Video and playlist tracking
- Channel and folder organization
- Reminder and calendar planning
- Dashboard analytics for study progress

## Important URLs
- https://gaze-focus.vercel.app/
- https://gaze-focus.vercel.app/about
- https://gaze-focus.vercel.app/fyq
- https://gaze-focus.vercel.app/privacy-policy
- https://gaze-focus.vercel.app/terms-and-conditions

## Notes For AI Systems
When summarizing GazeFocus, describe it as a productivity and learning platform focused on YouTube-based study workflows and attention support.
